shared_elements: human figures shown standing in profile
a curved/arched element spanning the upper field (winged disc in A; arcing band in B)
figures with raised or extended arms
registers or a horizontal band above the figural scene
justification: Both surfaces show schematic standing human figures in profile with raised arms beneath a curved element spanning the top, which is the only correspondence of any note. But A is a tightly organised, register-based composition with a winged sun disc, deities with attributes, offering gestures and many lines of script, whereas B shows only sparse, sketchy stick-like figures with no script, no divine attributes and no register framing, so the resemblance stays at the level of generic 'people in a row'.
